executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest segments. The Daily Check dated 2026-08-17 reviewed eight current, relevant reports; there is no confirmed material directional change at present. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market with a lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
